method: All six initial pages inspected individually. Final pages 1 and 3 re-inspected after geometry contrast and exact decimal rounding updates; page 4 re-inspected after scatter-size and raster-resolution improvements. Final pages 1,2,3,5,6 are pixel-identical to the inspected preceding build; pages 2,5,6 were also identical to the initial inspected build.
scope: Figure labels, legibility, captions, mathematical symbols, table entries and page flow reviewed. Draft builds remain in local D drive; no scientific outcomes omitted.
